description: This file contains tests for the helper functions used in the image-generation live testing module. It imports testing utilities from 'vitest' and various helper functions, then defines a suite of test cases to verify parsing, configuration resolution, and security features like API key redaction.

methods.name: parseCaseFilter
methods.description: Parses case filters, treating empty or 'all' as unfiltered, returning a set of case identifiers.

methods.name: parseCsvFilter
methods.description: Parses CSV filter strings, splitting and trimming entries, treating 'all' or empty as unfiltered.

methods.name: parseProviderModelMap
methods.description: Converts a CSV string of provider/model pairs into a Map of provider to model.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredLiveImageModels
methods.description: Resolves primary and fallback models from the given configuration into a Map of provider to model.

methods.name: resolveLiveImageAuthStore
methods.description: Determines the appropriate authentication store configuration based on environment flags.

methods.name: redactLiveApiKey
methods.description: Redacts sensitive API key information for secure diagnostics.
